name: converter of converter_device.json at short-circuit ratios from 10 to 1.2
description: Eighteen cases: the converter behind a grid of short-circuit ratio 10, 5, 3, 2, 1.5 and 1.2 (X/R 10), each with a three-phase fault at the point of connection for 150 ms that leaves 0.2 per unit, a phase jump of +30 degrees and a voltage step of -10 %, all at 0.2 s. Every limit is an example value of the user, not a threshold of a grid code: replace it with the value and the clause of the requirement that applies (kind document).

criteria.name: p_recovery
criteria.description: The active power returns within 0.05 per unit of its value before the disturbance, 0.5 s after the disturbance (the clearing of the fault) at the latest.

source.note: Example value for this example, not from a grid code.

criteria.name: stable
criteria.description: The active power does not swing by more than 0.01 per unit in the last 0.1 s of the run.

source.note: Example value for this example, not from a grid code.

criteria.name: poi_overvoltage
criteria.description: The positive-sequence voltage at the point of connection stays at or below 1.3 per unit for 0.2 s after the start of the disturbance and at or below 1.1 per unit after that.

source.note: Example value for this example, not from a grid code.

criteria.name: current_thd
criteria.description: The total harmonic distortion of the current of phase a over the last 10 periods of the run.

source.note: Example value for this example, not from a grid code.
